Karthik / Laura —

Forwarding request from Metanova. They want a $12,500 top-up credit memo that explicitly references PO-4721 and offsets INV-20280701. They want the memo to include the line "Promotional top-up in support of pilot; no revenue recognition impact to extend evaluation period." Can we:

- Approve issuing the credit memo from Redwood (promo allowance)

Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick: pilot voucher top-up + accounting question

Tessa / Laura —

Thanks for flagging. Quick internal guidance: finance is comfortable approving a $12,500 promotional credit memo as an allowance (contra-revenue) provided:

- It is recorded to GLA 6200-Promo-Allowance (promo expense/contra-revenue)
- The credit memo references PO-4721 and INV-20280701 in the memo body/field for matching
- We include the phrase "Promotional top-up (pilot extension) — non-recurring allowance" to preserve audit trail

Operationally: AR will issue a credit memo number CM-20280716-9382 and apply it to the open invoice INV-20280701 to net the receivable. Accounting will not reverse recognized revenue retroactively (this is an allowance against future invoicing as of the invoice date); tax treatment handled as reduction to gross revenue.

I can approve this as long as Legal signs off on the wording (to avoid commitment language). Laura — can you quick-run the memo language? If good, I'll ask AR to generate the draft CM PDF and share it.

-Karthik
